run_count_weights_test: run the CountWeightsTest suite to verify count_weights counts trainable TensorFlow variables correctly
test_count_trainable: test that count_weights returns the total number of trainable variable elements in the graph
test_ignore_non_trainable: test that count_weights returns zero when all variables are marked non-trainable
test_restrict_scope: test that count_weights with a scope argument only counts variables within that scope and its children
test_exclude_by_regex: test that count_weights with an exclude regex skips variables matching the pattern
